en: Changed `/security-review` to ask before Claude runs it, and skills' inline git commands to stop in bare-repository worktrees and similar folders until you allow them, outside auto mode and bypass
zh: 变更了 `/security-review`，在 Claude 运行前会先询问；并将 skills 中的内联 git 命令改为在裸仓库 worktree 及类似文件夹中暂停，直到你允许，自动模式和 bypass 除外
